name: plan-progress
description: Panel above the prompt for multi-step work and /goal: goal, phase, task checklist, progress bar, elapsed time, and a chime when a turn ends. Zero model calls.

sound.title: Chime when a turn finishes
sound.description: Plays sounds/done.wav at the end of each main-loop turn (macOS afplay).

minSteps.title: Minimum steps before the panel shows
minSteps.description: The panel shows for a /goal at any size, and for a task list once it has this many steps.
